title: Solving the Line-Based Dial-a-Ride Problem by Generating Stopping Patterns
summary: In the line-based dial-a-ride problem (liDARP), vehicles operate along a predefined bus line, with the possibility of skipping stations and turning when empty. Motivated by the practical observation that tight passenger time windows often limit pooling in on-demand services, we introduce a new variant of this transportation system by removing all temporal constraints, which we call the liDARP without TWs.
